real_time_result_rate.description: Percentage of results that happened out of all impressions on your ads.

secondary_goal_result.label: Deep funnel result
secondary_goal_result.description: Number of times your ad resulted in an intended outcome based on the deep funnel event you selected.

cost_per_secondary_goal_result.label: Cost per deep funnel result
cost_per_secondary_goal_result.description: Average cost per each deep funnel result from your ads.

secondary_goal_result_rate.label: Deep funnel result rate
secondary_goal_result_rate.description: Percentage of deep funnel results out of total impressions on your ads.

video_play_actions.label: Video views
video_play_actions.description: Number of times your video started to play. For each video impression, plays are counted separately and replays are excluded.

video_watched_2s.label: 2-second video views
video_watched_2s.description: Number of times your video was played for at least 2 seconds. For each video impression, plays are counted separately and replays are excluded.

video_watched_6s.label: 6-second video views
video_watched_6s.description: Number of times your video was played for at least 6 seconds. For each video impression, plays are counted separately and replays are excluded.

video_views_p25.label: Video views at 25%
video_views_p25.description: Number of times your video was played at least 25% of its length. For each impression, views are counted separately and replays are excluded.

video_views_p50.label: Video views at 50%
video_views_p50.description: Number of times your video was played at least 50% of its length. For each impression, views are counted separately and replays are excluded.

video_views_p75.label: Video views at 75%
video_views_p75.description: Number of times your video was played at least 75% of its length. For each impression, views are counted separately and replays are excluded.

video_views_p100.label: Video views at 100%
video_views_p100.description: Number of times your video was played 100% of its length. For each impression, views are counted separately and replays are excluded.

average_video_play.label: Average play time per video view
average_video_play.description: Average time your video was played per single video view, including any time spent replaying the video.

average_video_play_per_user.label: Average play time per user
average_video_play_per_user.description: Average time your video was played per user, including any time spent replaying the video.

engaged_view.label: 6-second focused views
engaged_view.description: Number of times your video was played for at least 6 seconds, played in full if it is less than 6 seconds, or received at least 1 engagement within the first 6 seconds.

paid_engaged_view.label: 6-second focused views (paid views)
paid_engaged_view.description: Number of times your video was played for at least 6 seconds, or played in full if it is less than 6 seconds. For each video impression, plays are counted separately and replays are excluded. Note : If you want to use this metric, you can specify any of the following dimension groupings in the `dimensions` field of the request: one ID dimension ( `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, or `ad_id`) one ID dimension + `stat_time_day`

paid_engagement_engaged_view.label: 6-second focused views (paid interactions)
paid_engagement_engaged_view.description: The number of times your video received at least one positive interaction (likes, shares, follows, or clicks) without being viewed for 6 seconds. This metric is only available for advertisers using focused view products. For each video impression, paid interactions are counted separately and replays are excluded. Note : If you want to use this metric, you can specify any of the following dimension groupings in the `dimensions` field of the request: one ID dimension ( `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, or `ad_id`) one ID dimension + `stat_time_day`

engaged_view_15s.label: 15-second focused views
engaged_view_15s.description: Number of times your video was played for at least 15 seconds, played in full if it is less than 15 seconds, or received at least 1 engagement within the first 15 seconds.

paid_engaged_view_15s.label: 15-second focused views (paid views)
paid_engaged_view_15s.description: The number of times your video was viewed for at least 15 seconds, or viewed in full if it is less than 15 seconds long. For each video impression, plays are counted separately and replays are excluded. This metric is only available for advertisers using focused view products. Note : If you want to use this metric, you can specify any of the following dimension groupings in the `dimensions` field of the request: one ID dimension ( `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, or `ad_id`) one ID dimension + `stat_time_day`

paid_engagement_engaged_view_15s.label: 15-second focused views (paid interactions)
paid_engagement_engaged_view_15s.description: The number of times your video received at least one positive interaction (likes, shares, follows, or clicks) without being viewed for 15 seconds. This metric is only available for advertisers using focused view products. For each video impression, paid interactions are counted separately and replays are excluded. Note : If you want to use this metric, you can specify any of the following dimension groupings in the `dimensions` field of the request: one ID dimension ( `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, or `ad_id`) one ID dimension + `stat_time_day`

engagements.label: Clicks (all)
engagements.description: Number of clicks from your ads. This includes clicks that lead to destination as well as those for social and interaction purposes.

engagement_rate.label: CTR (all)
engagement_rate.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in a click out of all impressions.

clicks_on_music_disc.label: Sound clicks
clicks_on_music_disc.description: Number of clicks on the sound associated with your ad during the ad impression.

duet_clicks.label: Duet button clicks
duet_clicks.description: Number of clicks on the "Duet" button.

stitch_clicks.label: Stitch button clicks
stitch_clicks.description: Number of clicks on the "Stitch" button.

sound_usage_clicks.label: Use sound button clicks
sound_usage_clicks.description: Number of clicks on the "Use sound" button.

anchor_clicks.label: Anchor clicks
anchor_clicks.description: Number of clicks on ad anchors.

anchor_click_rate.label: Anchor click rate
anchor_click_rate.description: Percentage of anchor clicks out of all impressions on your ads.

clicks_on_hashtag_challenge.label: Hashtag clicks
clicks_on_hashtag_challenge.description: Number of clicks on the hashtag challenge associated with your ad during the ad impression.

follows.label: Paid follows
follows.description: Number of follows to the associated profile during the ad impression.

likes.label: Paid likes
likes.description: Number of times your ad was liked during the ad impression.

comments.label: Paid comments
comments.description: Number of comments sent on your ad during the ad impression.

shares.label: Paid shares
shares.description: Number of shares of your ad during the ad impression.

profile_visits.label: Paid profile visits
profile_visits.description: Number of visits to the associated profile during the ad impression.

profile_visits_rate.label: Paid profile visit rate
profile_visits_rate.description: Percentage of profile visits from ads out of all impressions on your ads.

tt_playlist_visit.label: Playlist page visit
tt_playlist_visit.description: The number of playlist page visits the paid ad drove during the campaign.

tt_playlist_visit_rate.label: Playlist page visit rate
tt_playlist_visit_rate.description: The rate of playlist page visits per impression the paid ad drove during the campaign.

cost_per_consideration.label: Cost per consideration
cost_per_consideration.description: Average cost per consideration audience from your ad. Note : If you want to use this metric, you can specify any of the following dimension groupings in the `dimensions` field of the request: one ID dimension ( `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, `ad_id` , or `ad_id_v2` ) one ID dimension + `stat_time_day`

new_consideration_rate.label: New consideration rate
new_consideration_rate.description: Percentage of consideration audience acquired from all ad impressions. Note : If you want to use this metric, you can specify any of the following dimension groupings in the `dimensions` field of the request: one ID dimension ( `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, `ad_id` , or `ad_id_v2` ) one ID dimension + `stat_time_day`

new_consideration_size.label: New consideration size
new_consideration_size.description: Number of acquired consideration audience your ad resulted in. Note : If you want to use this metric, you can specify any of the following dimension groupings in the `dimensions` field of the request: one ID dimension ( `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, `ad_id` , or `ad_id_v2` ) one ID dimension + `stat_time_day`

complete_payment_roas.label: Purchase ROAS (website)
